planned_task.title: New skill: karpathy-principles SKILL.md for injectable discipline slot

existing_skill_contracts: Current skills use YAML frontmatter with `name` and a falsifiable `description`, followed by Overview and When to Use sections.
`skills/index.yaml` is the dependency registry replacing per-skill prose Integration sections.
`stage6-rubric` requires M1 skills to include governance anchors and enough depth for structured-content review.
`scripts/azoth-deploy.py` treats canonical `skills/**/SKILL.md` files as source and projects them into shared generated skill surfaces.
t_krp_a_boundary: T-KRP-A already chose the root CLAUDE.md layer as the lowest-effort always-on instruction slice.
T-KRP-B should be a separate on-demand skill so the Karpathy discipline can be injected without increasing root instruction weight.
T-KRP-C, T-KRP-D, and T-KRP-E remain separate follow-ons for builder posture, orchestrator assumption surfacing, and structured-autonomy success-criteria gating.

spec_direction.intent: Hydrate a governed M1 spec for adding a dedicated `karpathy-principles` skill as an on-demand behavioral discipline slot.
scope: Create canonical `skills/karpathy-principles/SKILL.md` with Azoth-native frontmatter, governance anchor, Overview, When to Use, principle guidance, and a concrete usage pattern.
Register the skill in `skills/index.yaml` with a one-line description and explicit dependency list.

Run `python3 scripts/azoth-deploy.py` after source skill changes and verify `python3 scripts/azoth-deploy.py --check` so `.agents/skills/karpathy-principles/SKILL.md` and other enabled mirrors stay generated.
Keep the skill load-triggered: use it for coding, review, planning, refactoring, or high-autonomy execution where the four principles materially reduce risk.

Add an Integration section or equivalent usage surface that names how pipelines/skills should invoke the discipline slot, including the expectation that stage6-rubric can evaluate it when invoked by skill or pipeline review paths.
non_goals: No root CLAUDE.md expansion in T-KRP-B.
No manual edits to generated AGENTS.md or generated skill mirrors.
No builder agent posture rewrite; reserve that for T-KRP-C.
No orchestrator goal-classification policy rewrite; reserve that for T-KRP-D.
No structured-autonomy-plan success-criteria gate implementation; reserve that for T-KRP-E.
acceptance: The hydrated T-KRP-B spec names the research capsule as planning evidence and keeps implementation behind a later governed M1 scope.
The future implementation scope creates exactly one canonical new source skill plus the index entry, then regenerates mirrors rather than editing generated surfaces by hand.
The skill satisfies stage6-rubric expectations for M1 skills: falsifiable invocation cue, governance anchor, Overview, When to Use, and at least one concrete usage pattern.
The skill adapts the upstream four-principle shape to Azoth's existing workflow instead of copying external text wholesale or duplicating T-KRP-A root guidance.
The future delivery verifies skill projection and targeted tests for deployment or skill indexing behavior.
The future delivery records model-tier auditability for any routed Wave A/Wave B/review/eval stages instead of hiding tier choices in chat history.
The future delivery preserves gate/readiness boundaries: no implementation without a fresh approved T-KRP-B scope gate and required governed pipeline gate.

integration_expectations: If the skill is invoked by pipelines or other skills, stage6-rubric review should cover the Integration section or equivalent invocation guidance.
Generated mirrors must be refreshed through azoth-deploy rather than manually edited.

D44 governs the structured-content quality rubric for skill definitions.
D51 governs M1 promotion and human-gated governance expectations.
